name: Karen Cliche
bio: Karen Cliche is a Canadian actress. She has appeared in roles on the television series Vampire High, Adventure Inc., Mutant X, Young Blades and Flash Gordon. Some can even label her a scream queen in her performance in Saw VI (2009) and Thanksgiving (2023).
